'''Brangan Zapakaj''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Courier/Legends|courier]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Lasha Bindari]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with rendezvousing with him.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Brangan Zapakaj]]
Brangan Zapakaj was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
